data.name: Settings.FallbackRowsDescription
data.value: 0–5, default 3. 0 disables the home fallback. Each home row is a separate Command Palette fallback command (platform limitation: one row = one fallback command), so this page shows N switches for N rows — enable all of them to see N rows. Changing the count requires reloading the Command Palette extensions. Note: third-party fallbacks are excluded from global results by default; enable it under Command Palette's Fallback commands and tick "Include in global results".

data.name: Settings.SortDescription
data.value: Passed to es.exe as -sort; the extension re-ranks results by relevance afterwards.
